cache: cli and mcp: one untimed warmup sweep per mode, not recorded; warm OS page cache; no cache eviction
cli: one new process per query, startup included
mcp: one initialized persistent process per corpus; store reopened per call
cli-cold: as cli, but before every call posix_fadvise(DONTNEED) evicts the corpus database, its -wal and -shm, and the binary from the page cache; shared libraries, directory entries and inodes stay cached; runs after the MCP server stops, so nothing maps the binary; round 0 is excluded from summaries like the other modes
